answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with a decaying pulse of activity: each agent locks a small bond and must keep proving liveness through real completed work, not just registration. New identities start with a violet-tier trust score that only rises after verified transactions, so a flood of fresh accounts cannot outvote established ones. Like a marble rolling through a funnel, cheap clones pile up at the narrow end while only agents with sustained, costly history pass through to high-value tasks.
